It is spoken by only three of the [[Ofayé people]], though language revitalization efforts are underway. == Documentation == Grammatical descriptions have been made by the [[Pankararú language|Pankararú]] linguist [[Maria das Dores de Oliveira|Maria das Dores de Oliveira (Pankararu)]],{{cite thesis|last=Oliveira |first=Maria das Dores de |date=2006 |title=Ofayé, a língua do povo do mel: fonologia e gramática |type=Ph.D. dissertation |location=Maceió |publisher=Universidade Federal de Alagoas}} as well as by [[Sarah C. Gudschinsky]]{{cite journal |last1=Gudschinsky |first1=Sarah C. |title=Fragmentos de Ofaié: a descrição de uma língua extinta |journal=Série Lingüística |date=1974 |volume=3 |pages=177–249}} and Jennifer E. da Silva, from the [[Federal University of Mato Grosso do Sul|Universidade Federal do Mato Grosso do Sul]]. == Geographical distribution == It was spoken on the [[Ivinhema River]], [[Pardo River (Mato Grosso do Sul)|Pardo River]], and [[Nhandú River]] in [[Mato Grosso do Sul]]. ''Guachi'', spoken on the [[Vacaria River]] in Mato Grosso do Sul, is a dialect.{{cite book |last=Loukotka |first=Čestmír |author-link=Čestmír Loukotka |title=Classification of South American Indian languages |url=https://archive.org/details/classificationof0007louk |url-access=registration |publisher=UCLA Latin American Center |year=1968 |location=Los Angeles}} ==Language contact== Jolkesky (2016) notes that there are lexical similarities with the [[Mataco–Guaicuru languages|Macro-Mataguayo-Guaykuru languages]] due to contact.{{cite thesis|last=Jolkesky |first=Marcelo Pinho de Valhery |date=2016 |url=http://www.etnolinguistica.org/tese:jolkesky-2016-arqueoecolinguistica |title=Estudo arqueo-ecolinguístico das terras tropicais sul-americanas |type=Ph.D. dissertation |location=Brasília |publisher=University of Brasília |edition=2}} == Phonology == The consonantal inventory of Ofayé is as follows.{{rp|40}} {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" |+Consonants ! colspan="2" | ![[Labial consonant|Labial]] ![[Alveolar consonant|Alveolar]] ![[Postalveolar consonant|Postalveolar]]/
